set: LEGO Technic 42175 Volvo EC230 Electric Excavator (excavator booklet, bags 12-17)

input.model_so_far: Pump deck with a black side frame on each side (steps 19-20).

new_parts.name: up-beam15-1
new_parts.position: long black 15-hole cross beam bridging the two side frames

new_parts.name: up-hub-1
new_parts.catalog_name: Technic Pin Connector Hub with 2 Pins with Friction Ridges Lengthwise [Small Squared Pin Holes]
new_parts.position: light-grey pin connector hub with two pins, pressed into the beam

new_parts.name: up-rpin-1
new_parts.position: short red pin in the hub's centre hole

what_each_new_part_touches: Yellow box 1: the grey hub is pushed onto two holes of the 15-hole beam. Yellow box 2: a red pin is pressed into the hub's middle hole. The finished beam is placed across the model (arrow) over the two side frames.
where_everything_is_after: a 15-hole beam with a grey hub and red pin lies across the pump deck, tying the two side frames

why.problem_solved: Ties the two upright frames into one rigid structure over the pump.
why.why_these_parts: A long beam reaches from one frame to the other; the hub and red pin add a mounting point for the next parts.
why.sets_up_for_later: The cab frame is built on this beam.

review_note: The beam rests on the pins sticking out of both side frames; exactly which pins it sits on is not labeled. Hub holes are estimates.
